record.question: What are the '5 Keys to Safer Food' promoted by the WHO?
options: Keep clean, separate raw and cooked, cook thoroughly, keep food at safe temperatures, and use safe water and raw materials
Wash your hands, cook food, refrigerate food, avoid cross-contamination, and wash produce
Shop smart, cook well, handle leftovers properly, store food correctly and use safe water
Read labels, cook food to the recommended temperature, serve food immediately, throw left over and dont waste.
record.explanation: Answer A: Keep clean, separate raw and cooked, cook thoroughly, keep food at safe temperatures, and use safe water and raw materials. WHO’s five keys are: keep clean; separate raw and cooked; cook thoroughly; keep food at safe temperatures; and use safe water and raw materials. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241594639. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
